Contact particle field

Seeded flow, mid-morph outward displacement, and radial pointer repulsion are adapted from
https://github.com/imfemambocus/portfolio/blob/main/src/particles/shaders.ts

Original code copyright (c) 2026 Isfaaq M. F. Emambocus.

The source uses those formulas in GLSL for one site-wide particle field. This adaptation
samples Sharon's own “Let's talk” text and implements a bounded local Canvas2D spring field,
with native scroll input and a reduced-motion fallback.
